payload.title: Continuous uncertainty-conditioned E011 placement
payload.statement: Legal continuous uncertainty features may identify when a bounded blend or exact fallback from E011 toward E006 reduces catastrophic error more safely than hard regime specialists.
payload.evidence_for: Oracle per-well E011/E006 fallback gains 0.758726 RMSE and continuous blending gains 0.833518, so material hidden-label headroom exists.
payload.evidence_against: All legal cross-fitted placements fail. Hard logistic is best at only +0.006868 RMSE, 2/5 maps and 5/25 cells, with typewell-0 and high-GR-missingness regressions; continuous branches are negative; inner AUC is near random.
payload.next_test: Closed by T022/D023. Do not preregister E013 or retune fallback classifiers around the same legal feature space. A future experiment must generate new sequence/state evidence rather than route E011 versus E006.
